n: δι᾽ ἑαυτοῦ, (di᾽ he'autou) 'through himself' is only in traditional manuscripts (SBL+TR+Byz)
ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
αὐτοῦ (autou) 'of him' occurs in a few manuscripts (WH) instead of σου. (sou) 'of You.' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+Treg+TR+Byz)
ὡς ἱμάτιον (hōs himation) 'like a garment' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH+Treg)

καὶ κατέστησας αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σου· (kai katestēsas auton epi ta erga tōn cheirōn sou) 'and you appointed him upon the works of hands of you;' is only in traditional manuscripts (WH+Treg+TR)
χωρὶς (chōris) 'without' occurs in a few manuscripts (SBL) instead of χάριτι (chariti) 'by [the] grace' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+WH+Treg+TR+Byz)
Χριστόν (Christon) 'Christ' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
μέχρι τέλους βεβαίαν (mechri telous bebaian) 'until end unshakable' is only in traditional manuscripts (WH+Treg+TR+Byz)
με (me) 'me' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
εἴρηται (eirētai) 'it has been said' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of προείρηται, (proeirētai) 'it has been predicted,' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
τοῦ κόπου (tou kopou) 'the labor' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἱερωσύνης (hi'erōsunēs) 'priesthood' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἱερέων (hi'ereōn) 'priests' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισεδέκ· (kata tēn taxin Melchisedek) 'according to the order of Melchizedek;' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
γὰρ (gar) 'for' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of οὖν (oun) 'then' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἱερέων (hi'ereōn) 'priests' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
καὶ τῶν ἀνομιῶν αὐτῶν (kai tōn anomiōn autōn) 'and the lawless acts of them' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
σκηνή (skēnē) 'tabernacle' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
ὑμῶν (humōn) 'of you' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+Treg+TR+Byz) instead of ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH)
κεκαθαρμένους (kekatharmenous) 'pruned' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of κεκαθαρισμένους. (kekatharismenous) 'cleansed!' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
Θυσίαν (Thusian) 'sacrifice' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of θυσίας (thusias) 'sacrifices' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
προσφορὰν (prosphoran) 'offering' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of προσφορὰς (prosphoras) 'offerings' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ὁ θεός (ho theos) 'of the God' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
προειρηκέναι (proeirēkenai) 'to have predicted' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of εἰρηκέναι· (eirēkenai) 'to have said:' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
λέγει κύριος· (legei kurios) 'says Lord;' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
δεσμοῖς μου (desmois mou) 'my imprisonments' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of δεσμίοις (desmiois) 'prisoners' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἐν οὐρανοῖς (en ouranois) 'in heavens' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
μου (mou) 'of Mine' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
στεῖρα (steira) '[being] barren' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27)
ἔτεκεν, (eteken) 'she brought forth' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
κομισάμενοι (komisamenoi) 'being repaid' occurs in a few manuscripts (WH+Treg) instead of λαβόντες (labontes) 'having received' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+TR+Byz)
πεισθέντες καὶ (peisthentes kai) 'having been persuaded and' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
ἐπειράσθησαν, (epeirasthēsan) 'tested' is only in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+WH+TR+Byz)
αὐτὸν (auton) 'Him' occurs in a few manuscripts (TR+Byz ¦ ἑαυτοὺς (O=he'autous) themselves - G1438=F-3APM in: SBL+WH) instead of ἑαυτὸν (he'auton) 'Himself' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+Treg)
ὄρει (orei) 'mountain' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἢ βολίδι κατατοξευθήσεται, (ē bolidi katatoxeuthēsetai) 'or with arrow will be shot down' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
κρείττονα (kreittona) 'better things' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR) instead of κρεῖττον (kreitton) 'better thing' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz)
ἔργῳ (ergō) 'work' is only in traditional manuscripts (Treg+TR+Byz)
ὑμῖν (humin) 'you' occurs in traditional manuscripts (Treg+TR+Byz) instead of ἡμῖν (hēmin) 'us' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH)

ἀμήν. πρός Ἑβραίους ἐγράφη ἀπό τῆς Ἰταλίας διά Τιμοθέου.¶ (amēn pros Hebraious egraphē apo tēs Italias dia Timotheou) 'Amen. to Hebrews it was written from Italy through Timothy.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
